description: Find in a document (docs/DOCUMENTS.md §8.2). Query and text are each folded one code point at a time (NFKD, combining marks out, each code point lower-cased alone, a run of white space one space); a hit is where the folded query occurs, hits never overlap, and each is given in the page's own code points with up to `context` (default 40) either side. `limit` (default 1000) caps the hits listed.
